description: This file defines a static helper class 'Writer' and a generic struct 'Writer<TBufferWriter>' that facilitate writing serialized data to different buffer types and streams. It includes methods for creating writers, and the struct provides various methods to write primitive types and variable-length integers efficiently, managing buffer allocation and state. The implementation is optimized for performance, using span, unsafe code, and conditional logic for buffer management.

classes.name: Writer
classes.description: A static helper class providing factory methods for creating 'Writer<TBufferWriter>' instances with various buffer types and streams.

classes.name: Writer<TBufferWriter>
classes.description: A generic struct that provides methods for writing to an output buffer or stream, managing buffer state, and supporting efficient serialization of primitive types and variable-length integers.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Factory methods to create 'Writer<TBufferWriter>' instances for different buffer types and streams.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Disposes of the output buffer or stream if it implements IDisposable.

methods.name: Position
methods.description: Returns the current write position within the buffer.

methods.name: WritableSpan
methods.description: Returns the current writable span for writing data.

methods.name: AdvanceSpan
methods.description: Advances the current write position within the span.

methods.name: EnsureContiguous
methods.description: Ensures there is enough contiguous space in the current buffer to write the specified number of bytes.

methods.name: Allocate
methods.description: Allocates new buffer space when current buffer is insufficient.

methods.name: Write
methods.description: Writes a ReadOnlySpan<byte> to the current buffer, handling multi-segment writes if necessary.

methods.name: WriteByte
methods.description: Writes a single byte to the buffer.

methods.name: WriteUInt64

methods.name: WriteVarUInt7
